languages.details: can't speak any language except drumcap

details.publicNotes:
Drumcaps are friendly, curious, and sociable fungus creatures who originate from forests thick with primal magic. Their bodies are shaped like chubby mushrooms, with large, colorful caps, stubby legs, and long arms ending in hollow spheres reminiscent of drumsticks. To communicate with each other, drumcaps bang their arms on their caps, producing percussive beats whose subtle shifts of rhythm and volume weave together into a complex language all their own.

Drumcaps emerge when sufficiently large quantities of drumcap spores collect in the network of fungal mycelium beneath the forest floor, spontaneously causing dozens of the mushrooms above to grow drastically in size and awaken to sapience as drumcaps. Thus, every drumcap is born as a part of a larger brood, and drumcaps often maintain a close connection to their siblings throughout their lives. Drumcap broods typically cluster together into nomadic villages traveling to places in their forest with the thickest primal magic, which can change across the year due to the shifting of ley lines and other magical phenomena.

In addition to being a vital part of drumcap reproduction, drumcap spores have hallucinogenic properties. While drumcaps do not experience these visual effects, they appreciate that many other creatures do, and they provide spores to visitors to enhance the experience of listening to their music. Unfortunately, interest in these spores sometimes leads unscrupulous individuals to hunt drumcaps; poaching is particularly common in regions where the locals' inability to communicate with drumcaps leads them to drastically underestimate the drumcaps' intelligence.

Drums of Doom

Communities of drumcaps occasionally fall under the sway of malevolent forces such as demons or tyrannical humanoids. Other times, an individual drumcap grows spiteful and bitter after an outsider does harm to their kin, knowingly or not. Such leaders encourage their followers to seek revenge for their suffering or simply menace those who wander into the drumcaps' territory. The drumming of these malicious drumcaps is ominous, not welcoming, and the visions caused by their hallucinogenic spores are those of vivid terror.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 3.5/7/13 gp

Eligible Refinements weapons (bludgeoning), armor (light), shield, skill items (Acrobatics, Athletics, Diplomacy, Nature, Performance, Survival)

Eligible Imbued Properties bane, charisma, constitution, energy resistant (vitality), mind, mind shield, music, poison, poisonous armor, sensory (low-light vision), sturdy, tangle shield, wild, wisdom, wood

description.value:
Frequency Once per hour

Trigger The drumcap takes bludgeoning damage

Effect The drumcap takes the full force of the attack on their cap, releasing a high concentration of hallucinogenic spores in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] that persists for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}. Creatures who start their turn in the emanation take @Damage[2d4[poison]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic] save) and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

The drumcap beats happily at their cap and does a dance to distract those around them. All creatures within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60] must attempt a @Check[will|dc:17] save to avoid being entranced. This effect lasts for 1 round, but if the drumcap uses this ability again on subsequent rounds, they extend the duration. Once a creature succeeds at any save against Fascinating Cuteness, that creature is temporarily immune to Fascinating Cuteness for 24 hours.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the drumcap's cuteness.

Critical Failure As failure, except the fascination does not end if the drumcap attacks one of the creature's allies; it still ends normally if the drumcap attacks the fascinated creature.

With a successful cap Strike, a drumcap releases a small puff of hallucinogenic spores. The target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:17] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.
